description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_IDAccumulator, which manages a collection of HTML element IDs to prevent duplicates, with methods for building an instance, adding IDs, and loading a list of IDs.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_IDAccumulator
classes.description: A class that accumulates and manages unique HTML element IDs to prevent duplication within the purifying process.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Static factory method to instantiate and initialize an IDAccumulator, including loading a blacklist of IDs.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new ID to the accumulator; returns false if the ID already exists.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a list of IDs into the accumulator's lookup table without checking for duplicates.
